description.value: Grey Fox Brewing is a dedicated gluten-free brewery located in Lake Country (Winfield), BC, making it a notable stop for cyclists with celiac disease or gluten sensitivities. The brewery has an online shop and a beer-finder page, suggesting both taproom presence and wider distribution. Touring cyclists in the Okanagan wine and orchard corridor will find it a distinctive craft beverage destination.

address.value: 310 Hiram Walker Ct #105, Kelowna, BC V4V 0B2, Canada
